section.title: Lineage from tools
section.description: OpenLineage events from Airflow, dbt, Spark and the like, and dbt's manifest and run results, propose steps between the elements of the catalogue. Nothing is changed until someone accepts a proposal.
section.emptyText: A lineage source gives a tool an address and a push token: its jobs become proposed steps, their runs the steps' last runs.
section.whoCanAct: The module's managers set lineage sources up.

kindHints.openlineage: Run events (spec 2-0-x) pushed by Airflow, dbt-ol, Spark, Flink and other OpenLineage clients. Datasets are matched to elements by the OpenLineage namespace and name discovery gives them.
kindHints.dbt: manifest.json and run_results.json, uploaded here or pushed from CI. Models and sources are matched to elements of the platform by database, schema and name.

form.name: Name
form.platformHint: Where the dbt models live: Snowflake or a database platform.
form.noPlatform: No Snowflake or database platform you may see
form.aliasesHint: When a tool names a platform differently from discovery (snowflake://invented-org-shop for snowflake://demo12345): the tool's namespace and the one of the elements.
form.aliasInvalid: An alias names two namespaces such as snowflake://account
form.teamsHint: Who sees the source, its push tokens and its proposals. None: every user of the module. A new source is your teams' by default.
form.enabledHint: Paused, pushes are refused (409) and nothing changes.
form.notSaved: The lineage source was not saved

page.pushHintOpenlineage: OpenLineage clients post their events here (one event or an array of up to 100, at most 1 MB) with a push token. Clients that add their default endpoint (api/v1/lineage) to the address use it with a slash at the end.
page.pushHintDbt: CI posts manifest.json to …/dbt/manifest and run_results.json to …/dbt/run-results with a push token.
page.deleteConfirm: Delete the lineage source “{{name}}” with its push tokens and proposals? The steps made from its proposals stay.

tokens.title: Push tokens
tokens.help: A push token can do nothing but push to this source. It is shown once; Steward keeps only its hash. It stops working when it expires, is revoked, or its creator may no longer manage the source.
tokens.emptyHint: Create one for the tool or the CI job that pushes here.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.nameHint: What pushes with it, such as Airflow production.
tokens.addressesHint: IP addresses or CIDR ranges; none: any address.
tokens.creatorInactive: Stopped: its creator may no longer manage the source
tokens.rotateConfirm: Rotate the push token “{{name}}”? The current secret stops working at once.
tokens.revokeConfirm: Revoke the push token “{{name}}”? Pushes with it are refused from now on.
tokens.secretOnce: Copy the token now – it is not shown again.
tokens.secretHelp: Configure the tool with the address and the token:
tokens.configOpenlineage: OpenLineage client (Airflow, dbt-ol, Spark: environment variables)

dbt.title: dbt files
dbt.help: Upload the files of a dbt run (target/manifest.json first, then target/run_results.json). Only what the files say about lineage and outcomes is kept – never code, descriptions or messages.

proposals.title: Proposed steps
proposals.help: What the tools say about how data moves – waiting for a person. Accepting makes a step (documented where its result lives); rejecting keeps the proposal away until the job names other datasets.

empty.documented: No proposal matches a documented step yet.

proposals.rejectConfirm: Reject the proposal “{{name}}”? It stays rejected until the job names other datasets.
proposals.acceptHelp: A step is made from {{inputs}} input(s) to {{outputs}} output(s), with the tool as its runner. It belongs with the products of its outputs.
proposals.acceptChangeHelp: The step this proposal became is changed to the datasets the tool names now. Inputs and outputs you may not see stay.

cannot.noOutputs: Writes nothing in the catalogue: discover the element, or add a namespace alias to the source.
cannot.hiddenEnds: Names elements you may not see: someone who sees them all decides.
cannot.notAllowed: Who may change the products it writes to decides.
